Weekend update for anyone flying with an animal
Someone on the desk wanted you to know
Travel notice for animal passengers

Travelers should confirm their booking details with the Companion Animal Travel Desk before arrival. The team coordinates care from booking through pickup, and a ground team moves carriers carefully between services. Please keep documents ready, use a secure carrier, and follow staff guidance at every handoff.

For Caldreth, <<FACT F019>> and travelers should listen for further direction from the desk. For Port Isolde, <<FACT F027>> and any pet traveling there must remain under staff supervision until release. Do not change carriers or open enclosures unless a member of staff instructs you to do so.

If you are traveling with a pet, plan ahead and allow extra room for check-in and screening. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is ready to help with practical steps and arrival support. Please contact the desk directly before you travel.
